title: Celebrating '21
description:
April 15
April 15: Ronald Acuña Jr.'s two-run homer stakes the Braves to a lead, Miami ties it in the ninth, and Dansby Swanson answers with a walk-off single to bring Acuña home. Atlanta wins 7-6 and snaps the Marlins' four-game win streak.

title: Celebrating '21
description:
May 19
May 19: One pitch is all it takes. Ronald Acuña Jr. leads off the bottom of the ninth with a walk-off home run to beat the Mets 5-4, backing six strong innings and eight strikeouts from Charlie Morton at Truist Park.

title: Celebrating '21
description:
June 30
June 30: The most lopsided win in the history of the Braves-Mets rivalry. Ozzie Albies posts career highs with five hits, two homers and seven RBIs, all nine Atlanta starters score, and the Braves pile up 20 hits in a 20-2 rout.

title: Celebrating '21
description:
July 4
July 4: Down 7-3 entering the ninth, the Braves rally to force extras, then win it in the most unlikely way: with the bench empty, pitcher Max Fried steps in and lines a walk-off single to beat Miami 8-7 in 10 innings.

title: Celebrating '21
description:
August 6
August 6: The night the season turns. Atlanta climbs above .500 for the first time all year, riding a three-run rally sparked by a catcher's interference call and three RBIs from Adam Duvall to an 8-4 win over Washington.

title: Celebrating '21
description:
August 11
August 11: Joey Votto homers twice, the second off Will Smith to force extra innings. Ozzie Albies answers in the 11th with a 412-foot walk-off three-run shot, an 8-6 win that pulls the Braves into a tie for first in the NL East.

title: Celebrating '21
description:
August 15
August 15: Dansby Swanson homers for a third straight game, Freddie Freeman and Austin Riley go back-to-back, and the Braves complete a sweep at Nationals Park 6-5 to take sole possession of first place for the first time all season.

title: Celebrating '21
description:
September 30
September 30: Champagne at Truist Park. Ian Anderson deals, Jorge Soler and Austin Riley homer, and the Braves finish off a sweep of the Phillies 5-3 to clinch a fourth straight NL East title in front of 38,235.

title: Celebrating '21
description:
October 23
NLCS Game 6. Eddie Rosario's three-run homer off Walker Buehler puts Atlanta ahead, then Tyler Matzek strikes out Pujols, Souza and Betts with the tying runs in scoring position. Braves win 4-2 for their first pennant since 1999.

description: World Series Game 1 at Yankee Stadium. A 19-year-old Andruw Jones homers in his first two Fall Classic at-bats, off Andy Pettitte and Brian Boehringer, becoming the youngest player ever to go deep in the World Series. Atlanta wins 12-1.

title: 10 Best BravesVision Games of 2026
description: Chris Sale wins the 150th game of his career, allowing one hit over six innings with nine strikeouts. Matt Olson's three-run homer off Aaron Nola opens the scoring as Atlanta beats Philadelphia 6-2 and becomes the first club to 20 wins.
